notes.title: Full Release
notes.content:
The day has finally come - Anivenge is complete.

That isn't to say that there won't be any further development, there's plenty of room to add more levels and I have an idea for at least one more type of car but the game feels complete as it is.

In this update you'll find:
[list]
[*]An ambulance - make this car crash and you'll lose a point
[*]New player sprites! Choose which animal you want to play as
[*]2 New backgrounds. Now you'll have a bit more variety
[*]A few small bug fixes and level adjustments
[/list]

So grab the update and help those animals get their revenge!

notes.title: First Update!
notes.content:
The first update for Anivenge is finally here. It includes -
[list]
[*]A new hazard - the bomb
[*]A new background music track
[*]5 new levels
[*]Tweaked movement code
[*]Some bug fixes
[/list]

I'm already starting on the next update which will include another special vehicle, the ability to choose different animals to play as, additional levels and more!

Is there anything you want to see in the game? Let me know
